name: ai-app-factory
description: AI App Factory - multi-agent platform for discovering, scoring and specifying app opportunities

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aiaf/shared && npm run build --workspace @aiaf/api && npm run build --workspace @aiaf/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @aiaf/api" "npm run dev --workspace @aiaf/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @aiaf/shared && npm run test --workspace @aiaf/api
